classification: SYNTHETIC NONPROD UAT FIXTURE. Every record is marked SYNTHETIC UAT. Nothing here touches Taylor data, production or Firebase. No credential, token or secret is in this file.
tracedAgainst: origin/main b433d396 (2026-10-21). Routes and inputs below were read from the command source, not run.

prerequisites.text: The Ventana operating-company KEY is bound: eos_policy.tenant_operating_company_keys holds an ACTIVE row for (tenant, ventana). That is a SEPARATE HUMAN-AUTHORIZED procedure (the evidence file config/ownership/operating-company-keys.sandbox.json plus the reconcile CLI on Render). This script never writes it and never edits that file. If the key is not bound, the first write step refuses OPERATING_COMPANY_NOT_GOVERNED and the script stops with STOPPED_KEY_NOT_BOUND: the fixture WAITS for the key.

PR #2201 (persona harness allowlist) is merged and deployed, so the guarded transport is in force. This script also performs its own exact-match target check and passes the registered base URL explicitly.
EOS_PERSONA_ISSUER_CREDENTIAL is set by the operator (name only; never printed). The issuer is used here as an API client for governed commands, not as login proof.

synthetic-np-emp-warehouse-manager.domain: Warehouse (company reach only; a WAREHOUSE scope on a Ventana warehouse is a separate access act)

financeReuse: Finance Ventana reach ALREADY exists (census) for ownerExecutive, administrator (Finance reach), generalManager and financeAccounting (synthetic-np-emp-finance-controller). No Finance grant is proposed or accepted.

protectedObligations.text: OWNER 2026-10-21: the three existing Ventana intercompany receivables (eos_finance.obligations, operating_company_id = ventana) are PROTECTED. This script never writes, re-keys, reassigns or mixes them with fixtures. It reads them (read-only listObligations as financeAccounting) before and after every apply and refuses if they changed. Synthetic Ventana finance fixtures, if ever created, would be separate rows; S57 is plan-only so none are created here.

steps.title: Ventana sales agreement (SYNTHETIC; DRAFT)
steps.traced: salesAgreementCommandService.createSalesAgreement (salesAgreement.create) + buildCreateSalesAgreement: requires opportunityId, ownerEmployeeId and at least one line; the company is the Opportunity's (do NOT state operatingCompanyId); a SERVICE line must state businessUnitId SERVICE|INSTALLATION; unitPrice (minor units) is required later to accept. accountId, currency, totals are server-derived and refused if sent. Returns salesAgreementId.

steps.title: Accept the sales agreement (SYNTHETIC)
steps.traced: salesAgreementCommandService.acceptSalesAgreement (salesAgreement.accept): DRAFT -> ACCEPTED; refuses COMPANY_REQUIRED if the Agreement has no operating company and UNPRICED_LINE if any line has no unitPrice; both satisfied by S51/S52.

steps.title: Close the opportunity as WON and book the Sales Order (SYNTHETIC)
steps.traced: opportunityCommandService.closeOpportunityAsWon (opportunity.write + opportunity.createSalesOrder): needs the ACCEPTED Agreement and stage DECISION; derives the Sales Order (state CONFIRMED, company and channel from the source) and returns salesOrderId. Replays by idempotency key return the same ids.

steps.title: Ventana Work Order for the Ventana Sales Order (SYNTHETIC)
steps.traced: workOrderOperations.createWorkOrder -> workOrderCreateCommand.createWorkOrder (workOrder.create): operatingCompanyId is the stated command context (not a body field of the command); it must be one the caller reaches and needs the bound key; accepted fields are customerId, locationId, workOrderType (SERVICE_CALL|PM|INSTALL|WARRANTY|INSPECTION), priority 1-4, complaint, salesOrderId, salesOrderLines, idempotencyKey. The Sales Order must be CONFIRMED|IN_FULFILLMENT, of the same company and customer, and its site must match (the Agreement carried S50b). Line numbers start at 1.
steps.governedPath: Work Order command createWorkOrder (workOrder.create + company authority)
